find_input_output_files: find input and output file paths for mp4 videos in a directory tree with optional test-only filtering
track_sequence: track hand keypoints on a video sequence using a pretrained model and save results to a pickle file
run_eval_pipeline: run parallel hand-pose evaluation across multiple video sequences using a multiprocessing pool
compute_tracking_error: compute per-frame mean keypoint error between ground truth and tracked hand poses
load_pretrained_model: load a pretrained torch model for hand pose tracking from a file path
